events.summary: A Fresh New Look for MegaBlast Mayhem! We’re excited to share another step forward for Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem. events.title: Demo NOW on Steam — Development Update
events.summary: Hello everyone! We're excited to share another major milestone for Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem. The Steam Demo has officially been approved and is now listed as an upcoming release! This marks the first public step into the world of Verdantia, and we can't wait for players to experience the beginning of the MegaBlast Festival.
